corrections.why: The agency field holds a location code (section 5, township 142N, range 35W; the statewide list gives it as 5 142 35), not an owner. The county list codes the owner as Mn MFS, footnoted as the Minnesota Forest Service, now the DNR.

notes_for_editor: Build date, height, owner and the state ARMER site note come from the Hubbard county list; the statewide A-Z list agrees on the 1928 build and the ARMER note. Gone status rests on the FFLA county list with no date. The list does not explain the term ARMER, so the story does not expand it. No staffing, fire or removal records found. Access and visit fields left out because no source covers them. Two searches used. No photos added.
